entries.61c7b0be22c255b8: This business provides hotel services. The company, Keio Plaza Hotel, Keio Plaza Hotel Sapporo, Keio Presso Inn, Keio Prelia Hotel Kyoto, Keio Prelia Hotel Sapporo, Takayama Green Hotel and Livita operate it. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥59,690 million.

entries.6f4187e1dabd5acc: This business transports passengers by railway, bus and taxi. The company itself runs the railway business, while buses are operated by Keio Dentetsu Bus, Keio Bus and Nishitokyo Bus, and taxis by the Keio Jidosha Group. The company's railways are the Keio Line, Inokashira Line and others, and this is the core business of the company, supporting life along the lines. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥132,281 million.
entries.8523969bd24d619b: This business comprises retail and various services related to daily life along the lines. Many subsidiaries share the work, including department stores (Keio Department Store), supermarkets (Keio Store), credit cards (Keio Passport Club), household goods (Keio Artmann), bread and confectionery manufacturing and sales (Keio Foods), food and beverage (Restaurant Keio), childcare support, senior housing, funeral services, travel (Keio Kanko), advertising agency (Keio Agency), freight transport and moving (Keio Unyu), and information systems. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥136,363 million, the largest of the five reportable segments.

entries.c1143593d22d7d07: This business provides comprehensive building management, vehicle maintenance, and construction and civil engineering. Comprehensive building management is handled by Keio Setsubi Service, vehicle maintenance by Keio Jukiseibi and Tokyo Tokushu Sharyo, and construction and civil engineering by Keio Kensetsu and Keio Kensetsu Yokohama. Keio Kensetsu and Keio Kensetsu Yokohama undertake the construction and civil engineering work of the company. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥53,844 million.
entries.c41b3990a2aa35a4: This business leases and sells real estate. The company, Keio Fudosan, Livita, Sunwood, Keio SC Creation and others handle the leasing and sales businesses separately. In July 2024, the company succeeded the commercial facility operation business to Keio SC Creation, which was established in April 2024. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥114,759 million.
